mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prescriptions (id, workout_id, exercise_id, sequence, sets, reps, load, load_type, rpe) VALUES (#{id}::uuid, #{workoutId}::uuid, #{exerciseId}, #{sequence}, #{sets}, #{reps}, #{load}, #{loadType}::load_type_enum, #{rpe})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workouts WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}::uuid AND source = 'ON_DEMAND'::workout_source_enum

SELECT p.id AS prescription_id, p.workout_id, p.exercise_id, p.sequence, p.sets, p.reps, p.load, p.load_type, p.rpe, e.name AS exercise_name, e.body_part AS exercise_body_part, e.target AS exercise_target, e.equipment AS exercise_equipment, e.gif_url AS exercise_gif_url, e.image_url AS exercise_image_url FROM prescriptions p JOIN exercises e ON e.id = p.exercise_id WHERE p.workout_id = #{workoutId}::uuid AND p.removed_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.sequence
mapper.update: UPDATE workouts SET status = #{newStatus}::workout_status_enum, started_at = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN #{changedAt} ELSE started_at END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'COMPLETED' THEN #{changedAt} ELSE completed_at END, updated_at = #{changedAt} WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}::uuid AND status = #{expectedStatus}::workout_status_enum
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workouts WHERE source = 'ON_DEMAND'::workout_source_enum AND status = 'DRAFT'::workout_status_enum AND expires_at <= #{expiredBefore}
